topics.title: Kossel-Lewis approach, octet rule, Lewis structures and formal charge

concepts.learning_objective: Represent valence electrons with Lewis symbols and apply the octet rule to simple molecules.
Calculate the formal charge on atoms in a Lewis structure and use it to judge structures.
Identify incomplete octets, odd-electron molecules and expanded octets as exceptions to the octet rule.

topics.title: Ionic or electrovalent bond and lattice enthalpy

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the conditions that favour the formation of an ionic bond.
Define lattice enthalpy and explain its role in the stability of ionic solids.

topics.title: Bond parameters: bond length, bond angle, bond enthalpy, bond order, resonance and polarity

concepts.learning_objective: Define bond length, covalent radius, bond angle and bond enthalpy and use them in simple calculations.
Determine bond order and explain resonance using resonance structures.
Relate bond polarity and molecular geometry to the dipole moment of a molecule.

topics.title: The VSEPR theory and shapes of molecules

concepts.learning_objective: State the postulates of VSEPR theory and the order of electron-pair repulsions.
Predict shapes and bond angles of molecules whose central atom has lone pairs.

topics.title: Valence bond theory, orbital overlap and sigma and pi bonds

concepts.learning_objective: Describe covalent bond formation in H2 in terms of potential energy and orbital overlap.
Distinguish sigma and pi bonds by the type of overlap and count them in molecules.
Identify sp, sp2 and sp3 hybridisation and relate it to shape and s-character.
Explain sp3d and sp3d2 hybridisation in molecules such as PCl5 and SF6.

topics.title: Molecular orbital theory and bonding in homonuclear diatomic molecules

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the formation of bonding and antibonding molecular orbitals by LCAO and the conditions for combination.
Use molecular orbital configurations to find bond order, stability and magnetic nature.
Explain the cause of hydrogen bond formation and its effect on physical properties.
Distinguish intermolecular and intramolecular hydrogen bonds with examples.
